title: Doom refuses to yield to the Horsemen
summary: Ron Simmons and Butch Reed defend the tag championship against the Horsemen. Count-outs, substitutions and a street fight prevent either side from settling the rivalry cleanly.

chapters.title: The title match spills outside
chapters.result: Doom and Flair–Anderson fight to a double count-out.
chapters.context: The champions keep the belts, but neither team establishes superiority.

chapters.title: A street fight produces a double pin
chapters.result: Doom and Anderson–Windham draw in the tag title street fight.
chapters.context: Simultaneous pins leave the championships with Doom and the feud without a clear winner.
